question: A "part-time job" pays you ₹500 for three small tasks, then asks for a ₹10,000 deposit to unlock better-paying work. What is happening?
options: A task scam, where early payouts buy your trust
correct_answer: A task scam, where early payouts buy your trust

ai_feedback.correct: Correct. No legitimate employer requires payment in order to pay you.
ai_feedback.incorrect: The small payouts are the investment the fraudster makes to secure the larger one.

question: Why does an unregulated loan app demand access to your contacts?
options: To harass your contacts if you default
correct_answer: To harass your contacts if you default

ai_feedback.correct: Correct. The permission request tells you what the collection process will be.
ai_feedback.incorrect: No regulated lender needs your contact list to assess a loan.

question: You report an unauthorised transaction to your bank within two working days. What does RBI policy generally provide?

ai_feedback.correct: Correct — which is why reporting immediately matters more than anything else.
ai_feedback.incorrect: The protection is strongest within three working days and weakens after.
